method Histogram(test: string) returns (result: map<string, int>)
    requires test != null  // The input string should not be null
    ensures result != null  // The result should not be null
    ensures forall k: string :: k in result.Keys() ==> k in test.Split(' ') // All keys in the result are from the input string
    ensures forall k: string :: k in test.Split(' ') ==> (k in result.Keys() ==> result[k] > 0) // All letters in input have non-negative counts
    ensures result == (if test == "" then map<string, int>() else // If the input is empty, result is an empty map
                      let counts := CountOccurrences(test) in // Count occurrences of each letter
                      let maxCount := Max(counts.Values()) in // Find the maximum count
                      map<string, int> | k, v | k in counts.Keys() && v == maxCount // Create a result map with letters having the max count
                      )
